20: return _t"New Class Evolution: #LIGHT_GREEN#Technomancer (Archmage)",
21: _t[[#{bold}##GOLD#EUREKA!#LAST##{normal}#
22: 
23: As an archmage you are trained into the intricacies of the arcane forces, but as a tinker you know how to build and create. And suddently it hit you!
24: #{italic}#You now understand how to combine magic and technology!#{normal}#
25: 
26: You have unlocked the #LIGHT_GREEN#Technomancer class evolution#WHITE# for Archmages.
27: 
28: Features:#YELLOW#
29: - Occult Technomancy: Use a rapidly spinning steamsaw to rip appart reality itself and project arcane and temporal onslaughts
30: - Galvanic Technomancy: Create galvanic rods that link up to create deadly fields of fire and lightning to burn down your foes
31: - Terrene Technomancy: Craft and control swarms of micro spiderbots to damage and debilitate your foes with water and earth forces
32: - Arcane Dynamo: Casting spells generates steam and steam increases spellpower
33: - Access to physics and chemistry: All Technomancers know the basics of crafting tinkers
34: #WHITE#
35: 
36: Class evolutions are selected as prodigies and grant new ways to build and expand your class and are only visible to the concerned class.
37: ]]"}], "source_availability": "available", "limitation": "DLC 来源、源码 commit 与发行版本未固定；哈希仅绑定本次证据。"}, "terminology": [], "read_boundary": "只读以上 frozen_file 中本条相关定义；可沿调用链查询 manifest 固定 engine commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，本体源码位于 /workspace/t-engine4；DLC只沿本组件关联调用链读取 /workspace/tome4-dlcs/<component> 并记录来源未固定，不得全盘扫描。禁止读当前译文、当前术语库、其他 task 或旧裁决。"}

20: return _t"New Age of Ascendancy birth option: #LIGHT_GREEN#Tinkers",
21: _t[[You have defeated Outpost Leader John with two different tinker classes.
22: You can now create new characters with any tinker classes you have unlocked #LIGHT_GREEN#in the classical Age of Ascendancy, Infinite Dungeon and Arena campaigns#WHITE#.

20: return _t"New Race: #LIGHT_GREEN#Yeti",
21: _t[[
22: Yetis are native creatures to the cold mountains of the Clork peninsula, highly evolved bipedal animals they still lack true sentience.
23: Their white fur covers an extremely strong body, but their minds are weak.
24: Techno-psionics of the Kruk Pride have managed to devise a system to hijack a yeti's body, transferring their own mind into them to increase the Pride's fighting power.
25: 
26: You have helped capture multiple Yetis for such purpose and can now create a new character with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Yeti race#WHITE#.
27: 
28: Race features:#YELLOW#
29: - Algid Rage, call upon the harsh climate of their birthplace to freeze their foes
30: - Mindwave, the controlling orc retains a small part of his psionic powers, giving them a powerful mind-tool
31: - Strong body#WHITE#
32: ]]"}], "source_availability": "available", "limitation": "DLC 来源、源码 commit 与发行版本未固定；哈希仅绑定本次证据。"}, "terminology": [], "read_boundary": "只读以上 frozen_file 中本条相关定义；可沿调用链查询 manifest 固定 engine commit 624a67329fe2ad440c5b344785a9c73fcf22ae63，本体源码位于 /workspace/t-engine4；DLC只沿本组件关联调用链读取 /workspace/tome4-dlcs/<component> 并记录来源未固定，不得全盘扫描。禁止读当前译文、当前术语库、其他 task 或旧裁决。"}

20: return _t"New Class: #LIGHT_GREEN#Psyshot (Tinker)",
21: _t[[You have found extremely old machines powered by advanced psionics and technology. Psionics without a living mind was never thought possible.
22: You can now create new characters with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Psyshot class#WHITE#.
23: 
24: Psyshots are Tinkers that merge psionics and steamtech in a lethal blend, wielding a steamgun in one hand and a mindstar in the other.
25: Class features:#YELLOW#
26: - Project mindstar attacks with each bullet you fire
27: - Inspire dread to weaken your foes to your gunslinging
28: - Manipulate the very air around your victims
29: - Enter a psionic gestalt with your steam generators, boosting them#WHITE#

translation_snapshot.source:
#{bold}##GOLD#EUREKA!#LAST##{normal}#

As an archmage you are trained into the intricacies of the arcane forces, but as a tinker you know how to build and create. And suddently it hit you!
#{italic}#You now understand how to combine magic and technology!#{normal}#

You have unlocked the #LIGHT_GREEN#Technomancer class evolution#WHITE# for Archmages.

Features:#YELLOW#
- Occult Technomancy: Use a rapidly spinning steamsaw to rip appart reality itself and project arcane and temporal onslaughts
- Galvanic Technomancy: Create galvanic rods that link up to create deadly fields of fire and lightning to burn down your foes
- Terrene Technomancy: Craft and control swarms of micro spiderbots to damage and debilitate your foes with water and earth forces
- Arcane Dynamo: Casting spells generates steam and steam increases spellpower
- Access to physics and chemistry: All Technomancers know the basics of crafting tinkers
#WHITE#

Class evolutions are selected as prodigies and grant new ways to build and expand your class and are only visible to the concerned class.
translation_snapshot.target:
#{bold}##GOLD#我发现了！#LAST##{normal}#

作为一个元素法师，你在多年的训练中掌握了周围奥术力量的深奥知识，而作为一个工匠，你也掌握了建造和创造的能力。然后有一天，你突然发现了！
#{italic}#你掌握了把魔法和科技结合起来的技术！#{normal}#

你解锁了元素法师的#LIGHT_GREEN#科技法师 职业进阶#WHITE#。

职业特性：#YELLOW#
- 科技法术：玄机系——使用高速旋转的蒸汽链锯切裂现实，用奥术和时空的力量撕碎敌人。
- 科技法术：放电系——使用放电柱，链接出死亡的领域，用火焰和闪电的力量烧毁敌人。
- 科技法术：寒岩系——制造并控制微型蜘蛛机器人虫群，用水和土的力量伤害并削弱敌人。
- 奥术发电机：施放法术会制造蒸汽，蒸汽会提升法术强度。
- 获得物理学和化学技术：所有科技法师都掌握制作插件的基础技术。
#WHITE#

职业进阶是一种觉醒技，它们可以给予你新的方法来强化你的职业。只有相关的职业才能看到它们。

translation_snapshot.source:
You have defeated Outpost Leader John with two different tinker classes.
You can now create new characters with any tinker classes you have unlocked #LIGHT_GREEN#in the classical Age of Ascendancy, Infinite Dungeon and Arena campaigns#WHITE#.
Also tinker escorts may start to appear in Maj'Eyal now.

Playing characters this way is not lore-canon, but fun!
translation_snapshot.target:
你已使用两种不同的工匠职业击败前哨站首领约翰。
现在，你可以在#LIGHT_GREEN#原版战役、无尽地下城和竞技场#WHITE#中，使用已经解锁的任意工匠职业创建新角色。
马基·埃亚尔如今也可能出现工匠护送任务。

以这种方式游玩的角色不符合正史，但很有趣！

translation_snapshot.source:
Yetis are native creatures to the cold mountains of the Clork peninsula, highly evolved bipedal animals they still lack true sentience.
Their white fur covers an extremely strong body, but their minds are weak.
Techno-psionics of the Kruk Pride have managed to devise a system to hijack a yeti's body, transferring their own mind into them to increase the Pride's fighting power.

You have helped capture multiple Yetis for such purpose and can now create a new character with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Yeti race#WHITE#.

Race features:#YELLOW#
- Algid Rage, call upon the harsh climate of their birthplace to freeze their foes
- Mindwave, the controlling orc retains a small part of his psionic powers, giving them a powerful mind-tool
- Strong body#WHITE#
translation_snapshot.target:
雪人是克拉克半岛寒冷山脉的本土生物；它们是高度进化的双足动物，但仍缺乏真正的意识。
白色毛皮覆盖着它们极其强壮的身躯，但它们的心灵十分脆弱。
克鲁克部落的灵能科技人员设法设计出一套系统来劫持雪人的身体，把自己的意识转移进去，从而增强部落的战斗力。

你已经为此帮助捕获了多个雪人，现在可以使用#LIGHT_GREEN#雪人种族#WHITE#创建新角色。

种族特色：#YELLOW#
- 寒冰之怒，利用它们故乡的严酷气候冻结敌人。
- 脑波冲击，控制雪人的兽人仍保留着一小部分灵能力量，赋予雪人强大的心灵武器。
- 强大的身躯#WHITE#

translation_snapshot.source:
You have found extremely old machines powered by advanced psionics and technology. Psionics without a living mind was never thought possible.
You can now create new characters with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Psyshot class#WHITE#.

Psyshots are Tinkers that merge psionics and steamtech in a lethal blend, wielding a steamgun in one hand and a mindstar in the other.
Class features:#YELLOW#
- Project mindstar attacks with each bullet you fire
- Inspire dread to weaken your foes to your gunslinging
- Manipulate the very air around your victims
- Enter a psionic gestalt with your steam generators, boosting them#WHITE#

All Tinker classes use Steam for their powers.
translation_snapshot.target:
你找到了一些由先进灵能与科技驱动的极其古老的机器。没有生命心智的灵能从未被认为可能存在。
现在你可以在创建人物时选择新的职业：#LIGHT_GREEN#灵能射手#WHITE#。

灵能射手是融合灵能与蒸汽科技、形成致命组合的工匠职业，一手持蒸汽枪一手持灵晶。
职业特色：#YELLOW#
- 将灵晶的攻击投射到你发射的子弹中。
- 激发敌人的恐惧，削弱敌人，使他们难以抵挡你的枪法。
- 操纵你的受害者身边的空气。
- 与你的蒸汽发生器进入灵能格式塔，从而强化它们。#WHITE#

所有工匠系职业使用蒸汽作为能量。
[询问哪里可以学习插件制作]
